title: Incremental backup restart on Pager data-version change

scope.rationale: sqlite3BackupRestart invalidates all prior copy progress after a Pager detects an external or otherwise unclassifiable source-image change. The production backup owner represents iNext=1 with a restart-pending flag, preserving the most recently published remaining/page-count observations until the next step discards and rebuilds its retained serialized source image.
excluded_responsibilities: Per-page backupUpdate propagation for source writes
Incremental source-page copying and destination transactions
Backup attachment list registration and teardown

external_source_responsibilities: Pager reset publishes a wrapping data-version change
Backup step frees the owned stale serialized image before restarting
Connection backup lifecycle retains source and destination database owners
dependencies.caller_closure: The complete source restart wrapper is assigned. Production backup_step detects a changed Pager data version, releases its stale owned image, invokes backupRestartOwner, and serializes again from page one semantics.

outputs: No-op for null; otherwise restart-pending set while the most recently published progress observations remain unchanged
contracts.ownership: The restart primitive mutates backup-owned progress only. Its production caller frees any public-allocator serialized image before clearing the pointer, preserving allocator ownership boundaries.
contracts.state_and_results: Every attached owner is conceptually reset to source page one. The current production connection permits one public backup endpoint per object and represents iNext=1 with restart_pending; the next step regenerates the complete source image without prematurely changing nRemaining/nPagecount.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: No direct I/O or callback. Public backup_step owns connection synchronization; the source Pager data-version observation is read under that operation.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: Infallible. A restarted object remains valid and the next step may continue by reserializing; null is a no-op.

representation_differences: Source iNext=1 is represented by restart_pending; the next backup_step clears the retained serialized image and starts serialization from the source beginning while preserving prior remaining/page-count observations until that step.
The source linked list is represented by independently owned public Backup objects that each poll the shared Pager data-version counter when stepped.
Serialized image deallocation occurs when backup_step consumes restart_pending, so restart itself remains infallible and preserves the source observation timing.

oracle.protocol: Construct a native backup owner with nonzero progress, invoke the null owner boundary and then restart the live owner, and require restart-pending with unchanged remaining/page-count observations. Existing attached-backup differential replaces and mutates the source between partial and final steps and requires the destination to contain the replacement schema/data.
internal_observations: remaining pages and total page count before the next step
oracle.normalization: Compare exact restart flag, unchanged progress observations, and final destination SQL behavior.

assurance.oom: Restart allocates nothing; later reserialization reports existing backup allocation failures.
assurance.io_crash_concurrency: No direct I/O. Connection/Pager synchronization and public backup thread-safety remain owned by surrounding APIs.
assurance.malformed_input: Null is accepted. Non-null Backup is a typed live owner.
assurance.continuation: Cleared progress is reusable on the next backup_step.
assurance.performance: Constant-time restart after stale-image deallocation; next step recopies the source as required.

integration.native_call_path: Pager reset increments dataVersion; sqlite3_backup_step compares it with source_data_version, calls backupRestartOwner, consumes restart_pending by freeing the stale image, and serializes a fresh image.
integration.bounded_owner_retired: database_writes polling is retired because it missed reset/external-change events and conflated known local writes with source-wide restart.

independent_review.notes: Requires pinned-C restart trace, per-page update integration, assurance closure, and independent review.

known_blockers: Port source backupUpdate per-page propagation instead of always recopying the retained serialized image on detected source changes.
